newsitem.title: UK: Strong demand noted at London tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Strong demand noted at London tea auction.

text.p: Strong demand was noted at Monday's tea auction, which saw bright Burundi invoices selling well at a top price of 2.70 stg for the best types, the official report said.
Good liquoring Kenya teas were dearer, while coloury mediums advanced four to eight pence.
The offshore sector attracted keen competition with prices gaining several pence, particularly coloury dusts. The next auction will be held on March 10. -Stephen Grainger +44 0171 542 8074
